name: Serial (AMOS 1.3)
author: Europress Software

provenance.note: The AMOS 1.3 serial library, $VER 1.2. Its 15 named keywords are all in AMOS Pro's IOPorts, which absorbed serial, parallel and printer into one extension.
provenance.redistribution: Amiga Computing issue 66 coverdisk (November 1993), a commercial magazine cover-mount carrying a licensed AMOS 1.3 distribution. Kept as a fixture for identification and reference only.

findings: Identifies AMOS 1.3-era programs. The serial keywords are ported as part of IOPorts.
notes: The AMOS 1.3 serial extension. Its keywords are the ones IOPorts carries in AMOS Pro.
